item.title: Kraken launches US-listed stock trading for EEA customers
item.summary: Eligible EEA users can trade conventional US shares alongside more than 700 tokenized xStocks through Kraken’s European entity. Kraken has launched trading in more than 7,000 US-listed stocks for customers in the European Economic Area (EEA), expanding its traditional finance offering alongside cryptocurrencies and tokenized equities. The crypto exchange said Tuesday that eligible EEA customers can trade US stocks through Kraken Pro and its mobile app under the company’s Markets in Financial Instruments Directive II authorization. The shares are available alongside more than 600 crypto assets and over 700 xStocks, which are tokenized versions of publicly listed equities. Read more
